en-US.description: Local-first, lightweight issue tracker. Single binary, SQLite-backed, MCP-native.
en-US.longDescription:
An issue tracker for prolific agents. Plans and issues live on your server instead of in the context window, so work outlives the session. Agents use it over MCP; you use the web UI.

- 31 MCP tools in 5,781 tokens, about one long file read.
- One 25 to 32 MB binary with SQLite, the web UI and backups built in. No Docker, no Postgres.
- lific connect writes MCP config for 11 AI clients.
- Identifiers like APP-42, never UUIDs.
en-US.name: Lific
en-US.releaseNotes:
A web UI fix for issue previews.
Web UI
- Issue hover cards opened from links inside a page or issue body now show in full, instead of being clipped or pushed off the edge of the surrounding panel. Those links also stop showing a native browser tooltip on top of the card (PR #99 by @zorro432).

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的轻量级 issue 跟踪器。单一二进制文件，基于 SQLite，原生支持 MCP。
zh-CN.longDescription:
为高产出 AI 代理打造的 issue 跟踪器。计划和 issue 存放在你自己的服务器上，而不是代理的上下文窗口中，工作成果因此能够跨越会话留存。代理通过 MCP 使用它；你则使用 Web 界面。

- 31 个 MCP 工具仅占 5,781 个 token，约等于一次长文件读取。
- 单一 25 到 32 MB 的二进制文件，内置 SQLite、Web 界面和备份功能。无需 Docker，无需 Postgres。
- lific connect 可为 11 种 AI 客户端写入 MCP 配置。
- 使用 APP-42 这类标识符，而非 UUID。
